about_the_game: "Magic Brush (Demo)" is a new type of brick-breaking game. In this game, what the player controls is a magical pen, which leaves lines when swiping the screen. By skillfully utilizing the collision effect between the lines and the rabbit, the rabbit can be sent to the designated position.
detailed_description: "Magic Brush (Demo)" is a new type of brick-breaking game. In this game, what the player controls is a magical pen, which leaves lines when swiping the screen. By skillfully utilizing the collision effect between the lines and the rabbit, the rabbit can be sent to the designated position.

short_description: In "Magic Brush(Demo)", Players can press and hold the mouse to slide, generating obstacles on the screen to bounce the little rabbit, allowing it to cross numerous barriers and return home safely.The game has six themes, and nearly 100 levels, full of passion and challenge.
